summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then invokes that runtime against math_init.js, a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball (hex-named identifiers, string-array shuffler rotating an opcode-style array, '// @bun @bun-cjs' header). The payload runs automatically on npm install. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb (repository points at ornikar/orb-frontend-native and ships CircleCI orb YAML under src/), but the preinstall path executes an opaque Bun-compiled binary blob unrelated to any orb functionality; the mismatch between advertised purpose and the auto-executed payload, together with the use of an alternate runtime specifically to execute an unauditable bundle, matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern. The obfuscation prevents any static audit of what the payload does once it runs under Bun on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
